text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C at gains felt rewarding, but a gain versus my average cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should follow a portfolio plan instead of seeking the pleasure of locking in profits.","After account values fell, I bought more of all five stocks, then held through further declines. I should size purchases deliberately and avoid treating a dip or past prices as evidence of a rebound.","With random price movements and infrequent trading, I should review diversification and risk periodically, make decisions based on my current plan, and avoid reacting to short-term account changes."]}
